clue.text: Adopted you in a manner of speaking

definitions.text: Adopted you in a manner of speaking

blocks.note: surface reading: someone took you into their family as their own child
setter's reading: adopting is only loosely meant, as when an idea or a person is taken on and approved

explanation.surface: Someone tells you, rather loosely, that you were taken in by a new family.
explanation.walkthrough: The parenting sense is the decoy; the qualifier warns that 'adopted' is to be taken figuratively, as being received and approved of.
explanation.definitionFit: To adopt an idea or a newcomer is to take it on willingly and approve it, the common sense of the answer.

clue.text: A small loop put round the right fruit

explanation.surface: Instructions for decorating a dish: tie a little loop around the proper piece of fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: PICOT is a lacemaker's word, rarely met outside needlework.
explanation.definitionFit: An apricot is a small orange stone fruit, so it is an example of the general category named.

clue.text: Many going in the right direction to find an open space

explanation.surface: Crowds heading the proper way arrive at a large open area.
explanation.definitionFit: A concourse is a wide open area, as in a station hall or the space where roads and paths meet.

first letter of kept
